== Misattributed quote? ==

This scene seems to me to be from NS 10 (It Finishes), right at the culmination of Moiraine's test for the shawl. However, the line quoted is spoken by Merean, not Verin. Verin was present at the test, but the dialogue pictured was not spoken by her at that time. There may be another instance of it that I'm missing, of course.
